browser_dom_checks.method: Real headless Chromium rendered via Playwright set_content (in-memory document). No browser security policy was modified.
checks: All research loaded into real browser DOM
Draft task contents and safe filename
Saved shortlist works without persistent storage
Source facts and limitations all displayed
limitations: Browser administration blocks file:// and loopback navigation in this sandbox. Direct local-file opening and browser HTTP navigation were not end-to-end tested.
Loopback HTTP endpoints and security were exercised separately by Python integration tests.
Native download transport and persistent localStorage were not tested; generated export contents and session shortlist were tested.

classification_caveat: 331 records use domain-based subcategories and are flagged for precise-subcategory review. All 1512 records have a primary category and subcategory; assignments and scores are editorial, not demand evidence.
